Constraint.description: A rule or limitation on protocol execution.

expression.description: Boolean expression string (legacy; summary when predicate is set)
expression.title: Expression

predicate.description: Predicate name to evaluate this constraint
predicate.title: Predicate

Constraint.title: Constraint

ExecutionConfig.description: Branch execution configuration for task isolation.

auto_merge.description: Whether a successfully completed task's branch is merged into the base branch automatically. Default off; a mode may override it.
auto_merge.title: Auto Merge

max_recovery_depth.description: Maximum recovery depth per branch (default 3). Bounded against non-converging loops by recovery-stall detection and max_total_fix_attempts.
max_recovery_depth.title: Max Recovery Depth

prepare_command.description: Explicit environment preparation command executed after worktree setup and before task execution/validation. None = auto-detect from lockfiles.
prepare_command.title: Prepare Command

ExecutionConfig.title: ExecutionConfig

Mode.description:
Operational stage with defined permissions and transitions.

Transitions are DECLARATIVE only — they document the protocol's
intended mode handoffs but are NOT executed by the engine at
runtime.  The engine runs single-mode per invocation; cross-mode
handoffs are explicit user actions (snodo mode change <m>).

Transitions ARE read by ProtocolAdherenceValidator to provide
mode-profile context to the LLM.

auto_merge.description: Override the protocol-level auto_merge for this mode. None = inherit the protocol's execution.auto_merge setting.
auto_merge.title: Auto Merge

anyOf.description: Valid choices are the values in this enum.

concurrency.description: Concurrency ceiling for this mode. None = use coder_config.concurrency when set, otherwise 1.
concurrency.title: Concurrency

delivery.description: Override protocol delivery for this mode.
delivery.title: Delivery

max_recovery_depth.description: Override the protocol-level max_recovery_depth for this mode. None = inherit the protocol's execution.max_recovery_depth setting.
max_recovery_depth.title: Max Recovery Depth

items.description: Valid choices are the values in this enum.

transitions.description: Declarative event → target mode mappings (not engine-executed)
transitions.title: Transitions

Mode.title: Mode

Module.description:
A module — a scope that partitions the repository into named regions.

Implements ADR 041: a module is a structural concept, not an operational
stage. It declares which paths it owns, where its decision records live,
what tooling it uses, and which validators apply within its scope.

A protocol that declares no modules must compile and behave exactly as it
does today; the field is additive and backward-compatible.

decisions_path.description: Directory where this module's decision records live. When absent, ADR tooling falls back to the protocol-level setting.
decisions_path.title: Decisions Path

module_id.description: Unique module identifier (slug-safe alphanumeric with - and _)
module_id.title: Module Id

paths.description: One or more root paths this module owns. At least one is required.
paths.title: Paths

tooling.description: Per-module tooling map (same shape as the tooling field on Validator). When empty, tooling falls back to the protocol-level setting.
tooling.title: Tooling

validators.description: Validator IDs that apply within this module. Every ID must name a validator already declared in the protocol.
validators.title: Validators

Module.title: Module

QueueConfig.description: Default behaviour for runs started from a queue (ADR 053).

non_blocking.description: Whether a failed plan is passed over instead of stopping the queue.
non_blocking.title: Non Blocking

parallel_runs.description: Maximum plans to run concurrently in a non-blocking queue run. Read only when non_blocking is true.
parallel_runs.title: Parallel Runs

QueueConfig.title: QueueConfig

Severity.description:
Validator result severity levels.

Ordered: PASS < WARN < BLOCKER.  Explicit comparison operators
override the str-inherited lexicographic ordering.
Severity.title: Severity

Validator.description: Evaluation criteria and judging scope for a validator.

check_tool_access.description: When True, if a criterion demands verification by a tool outside this validator's own declared tools list, refuse rather than silently pass.
check_tool_access.title: Check Tool Access

evaluation_phase.description: When to run this validator (e.g., pre_execute, post_execute)
evaluation_phase.title: Evaluation Phase

judges_spec.description: Whether this validator's critique is about the spec's wording (intent, constraints, scope) rather than about the work. Only judges_spec validators' critique feeds the spec-authoring rewriter; a non-spec objection must not silently reshape the spec (Fixes #35).
judges_spec.title: Judges Spec

max_tool_turns.description: Optional read-tool-loop turn budget override for this validator. Falls back to the configured llm.validator max_tool_turns if not set.
max_tool_turns.title: Max Tool Turns

model.description: Optional LLM model override for this validator. Falls back to coder model / default_model if not set.
model.title: Model

scope.description: Unit this validator judges. A wave-scoped validator judges the wave containing the task; outside a plan, the task is its own wave.
scope.title: Scope

severity_cap.description: Maximum severity this validator can emit.  Useful for validators under evaluation: blocker capped to warn prevents blocking the workflow.  None = no cap.

tools.description: Read-only tool allowlist for this validator. Empty means no tool access (single-completion path). Allowed: ['git_log', 'git_show', 'list_files', 'read_diff_between_refs', 'read_file', 'read_file_lines', 'summarize_directory']
tools.title: Tools

validator_type.description: Type of validation (e.g., security, architecture) Valid choices are the values in this enum.
validator_type.title: Validator Type

Validator.title: Validator

exclusive_tools.description: Tools that must be exclusive to a single mode (approval-conferring). Default: approve + merge. A protocol may extend, but not shrink, this set — the defaults are always enforced.
exclusive_tools.title: Exclusive Tools

modules.description: Optional list of modules (ADR 041). A module is a scope — a named partition of the repository — not an operational stage. A protocol that declares no modules compiles and behaves exactly as it does today.
modules.title: Modules

protected_paths.description: Repository-relative paths that a task may not change. The engine checks the task branch diff after execution.
protected_paths.title: Protected Paths

write_allowed_prefixes.description: Project-relative path prefixes writable through the MCP write capability. Defaults to .snodo/.
write_allowed_prefixes.title: Write Allowed Prefixes

x-snodo-choices.description: Runtime choices for editor controls; provider/template choices are not protocol fields.

x-snodo-cross-field-rules.description: Protocol execution and each mode may not set delivery and auto_merge together; use delivery.
Each exclusive tool may appear in at most one mode (WF1).
Validators referenced by modes and modules must be declared; dispatch modes require a pre_execute validator (WF3).
initial_mode must name a declared mode (WF3).
Mode identifiers and validator identifiers must each be unique.
